reason: £300 is over a tenth of my monthly money, and it's a new seller with no reviews who wants me to collect and pay cash or transfer. On Marketplace I can find used sets for £150-200 from people with history, so I'd just keep haggling there.
objection: Are the tyres any good? It doesn't say whether tyres are included or what condition they're in, and there are no reviews, so I'd be paying cash to a stranger and trusting him that the wheels aren't bent or cracked.
would_change_my_mind: A price nearer £200 with tyres included and their tread depth stated, plus proof from real customers or photos of the actual set, and a chance to inspect them before paying.
